ATK-HE.description: High explosive grenade with a proximity fuse.

ATK-40CANNON.description: A heavy cannon capable of dealing high damage.

ATK-TRIDENT.description: Multi-barrel machine gun with extremely high rate of fire

ATK-HE-DRUM.description: Drum magazine allows more small HE grenades to be loaded.

ATK-HE-HIVEL.description: Fire faster-flying high explosive grenades at slower rates of fire

ATK-BFG.description: Big fearsome grenade that deals immense damage with one shot.

MISSILE-HIVE.description: When an enemy is marked it will automatically activate and when activated the use will fire 5 infra-red guided missiles to automatically track the marked enemy.

SMK-TRI.description: Deploy 3 Electro-static smoke screen grenades. Can effectively obscure the enemy's line of sight and recon device.

SMK-SQUID.description: Immediately deploy a smoke grenade around player.

TAC-EMP.description: EMP grenade with a proximity fuse. able to temporarily paralyze the enemy within range.

TAC-EMP-DELAY.description: EMP grenade with a proximity fuse. able to temporarily paralyze the enemy within range.

TAC-MINE.description: Automatically detonates when the enemy approaches, and can paralyze the enemy for a period of time

TAC-EMP-DRUM.description: EMP grenade with a proximity fuse. able to temporarily paralyze the enemy within range.

TAC-IMPLUSE.description: Applies an impact to players within range of the explosion, causing them to move

TAC-ADS.description: Active-Defence System will intercept any hostile flying object within range.

TAC-MED.description: The MED is able to automatically repair the spacesuits of the teammates nearby.

INFO-PROBE.description: Probes will mark enemies nearby after deployed.

INFO-SNAPSHOT.description: Activated by pressing the right button (LT), activation will mark all enemies within visible range.

INFO-MOTION.description: When an enemy passes near the motion sensor, the sensor will sound an alarm.

EMP-INF.description: Fire faster-flying high explosive grenades at slower rates of fire

IMPULSE-INF.description: Applies an impact to players within range of the explosion, causing them to move

EVENT-SQUID-INF.description: Immediately deploy a smoke grenade around player.

MISSILE-HIVE-DIRECT.description: When an enemy is marked it will automatically activate and when activated the use will fire 5 infra-red guided missiles to automatically track the marked enemy.
